title: New Light from Old Wax
paras: At Mina's small café, a [[toaster|toaster]] stands beside the bread basket. People come for breakfast or a bean [[burger|burger]] at lunch. But a [[recent|recent]] project has given them another reason to visit. Mina makes a new [[candle|candle]] from old pieces of wax. She collects these pieces in empty [[yogurt|yogurt]] pots near the door. A sign says, “We [[wish|wish]] we could use every last piece. Please bring yours here instead of throwing it away.”

The work happens on Monday, when the café is closed. First, Mina removes old strings and dirt from the wax. She separates it by colour, then puts one group into a metal bowl over hot water. As the wax slowly melts, she prepares thick glass jars made for candles. These are [[available|available]] at the [[nearest|nearest]] craft shop, just across the road. She fixes a new cotton string in the centre of each jar and carefully pours in the warm wax.

The jars stand overnight until the wax becomes hard. No large [[factory|factory]] is needed: Mina makes just six at a time. She has noticed a change in customer [[behavior|behavior]], too. More people now save their old wax. On Tuesday evening, the little lights shine on the café tables, ready for another meal.
zh: 米娜的小咖啡馆里，面包篮旁放着一台烤面包机。人们来这里吃早餐，或在午餐时吃一个豆子汉堡。不过，最近开展的一项活动让大家又多了一个来这里的理由。米娜用旧蜡块制作新蜡烛。她在门边放了几个空酸奶盒，用来收集这些蜡块。一块牌子上写着：“真希望每一小块蜡都能用上。请把你的旧蜡带到这里，不要扔掉。”
制作安排在星期一，那天咖啡馆不营业。首先，米娜去掉蜡里的旧烛芯和脏东西。她按颜色将蜡分开，再把其中一组放入架在热水上方的金属碗中。蜡慢慢融化时，她准备好专门用来装蜡烛的厚玻璃罐。这些罐子在最近的手工用品店就能买到，那家店就在马路对面。她在每个罐子中央固定一根新棉线，然后小心地倒入温热的蜡。
这些罐子要放上一夜，直到蜡变硬。整个过程不需要大工厂：米娜一次只做六支。她还注意到顾客的行为发生了变化。现在有更多人会留下旧蜡。星期二晚上，小小的烛光在咖啡馆的餐桌上亮起，迎接又一顿饭。

q.s: Mina makes the candles while the café is open.
q.why: 制作在星期一进行，当天咖啡馆不营业。

q.s: The craft shop gives Mina a lower price for the glass jars.
q.why: 只说明店里有玻璃罐，未说明是否优惠。

q.s: Mina makes six candles at a time.
q.why: 第三段明确说她一次只做六支。
